Interface IVeeplayRenderer

All Superinterfaces:
KRAdapter
All Known Implementing Classes:
CastRenderer, ExoPlayer2Renderer, ExoPlayerRenderer, Media3Renderer, MediaPlayerRenderer
public interface IVeeplayRenderer extends KRAdapter
Created by Andrei Marinescu on 26.03.2015. Interface used by Veeplay Renderer classes to communicate with the player and execute video rendering tasks
